## What changed

- `kmctl decision accept NUMBER` makes a draft decision record `stable`.
  It changes only the `status` line and adds a line to `.okf/log.md`
  naming the person who accepted it: `--by human:<id>`, or git's
  `user.email` when `--by` is left out. It refuses a record that is not a
  draft, and a `--by` that is not a person (ADR 0050, #66).
- `kmctl check --no-drafts` fails on every draft decision record and names
  the command that accepts it (#66).
- The CI action has a new input, `drafts`. With the default,
  `fail-when-ready`, the action fails a pull request that is ready for
  review while a draft decision is left, and passes drafts on a draft pull
  request. `fail` checks on every run, and `pass` never checks (#66).
- The knowledge rules say that the author of a pull request accepts or
  drops each draft decision before review, and that the agent runs
  `kmctl decision accept` only on the author's explicit yes (#66).
- The log records lifecycle events only: a concept created, renamed,
  superseded, deprecated, removed or regenerated, a decision accepted, or
  a concept verified. The knowledge rules no longer ask for a line when a
  concept is edited, and `kmctl new handoff --key` no longer logs an
  update of a handoff (ADR 0049, #65).
- `kmctl init` and `kmctl update` give `.okf/log.md`, `.okf/index.md` and
  `.okf/*/index.md` a union merge in `.gitattributes`, so a local merge
  keeps the lines both branches added. A kept `.gitattributes` gets only
  the lines it lacks (ADR 0051, #65).

## Before you upgrade

- Add `ready_for_review` to the `pull_request` types of the workflow that
  runs the action. Without it, marking a pull request ready does not run
  the check, and a draft decision can reach review:

  ```yaml
  on:
    pull_request:
      types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  ```

- The first pull request marked ready after the upgrade fails on every
  draft decision already on the default branch. Run
  `kmctl check --no-drafts` to list them, and accept or delete each one
  once. To keep the old behaviour, set `drafts: pass`.
- Run `kmctl update` once, and commit the `.gitattributes` it writes or
  changes.

## Other changes

None.

## Install

```sh
uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.16.0#subdirectory=packages/kmctl
```

In a workflow:

```yaml
- uses: JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.16.0
```

**Full diff**: https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl/compare/v0.15.0...v0.16.0
